title: JP's Combat Sport Strength and Conditioning
author: JP
desc:
The purpose of this program is to improve the power, strength, footwork, and conditioning of boxers, MMA fighters, and for any combat sport. This program is a 2x per week total body strength and conditioning program made to supplement your existing sport specific training. If you already have your fight training but dont have strength and conditioning, this program is perfect for you.  

This program is an 8 week program with 2 different microcycles. Weeks 1, 3, 5 and 7 are all the same and weeks 2, 4, 6, and 8 are all the same. Your goal is to improve all odd weeks to each other and all even weeks to each other. For every exercise, you want to improve technique week to week. Control, bar speed, and range of motion are all important. Once your technique is good, focus on speeding up/moving fast on the concentric (up portion) of every lift where applicable. Besides technique, control, and bar/rep speed, aim to go up in weight whenever possible *while* sticking to the assigned RPE's and *never* at the expense of technique.

For exercises listed as .5 minutes, that means 30 seconds of that exercise = 1 set. You can do 15 seconds one direction and 15 seconds back for the 30 seconds, or alternatively for all exercises with .5 minutes listed, you can do the exercise ~30 yards one direction and 30 yards back for 1 set.

ss.note: For these 4 exercise super set, go on circuit fashion. Do 1A, then 1B, then 1C, then 1D. Go back to 1A to repeat set 2.

ex.note: 1 set= 5 reps both sides. Each side means the back hand from both orthodox and southpaw.
As Many Reps As Possible in 6 Minutes with just the bar (45lb Bar). Take breaks as needed during the 6 minutes but the goal is to get as many reps as you can.

As many as you can get in 6 minutes, take breaks as needed. 
If too easy add light ankle weights.
Run either 3, 4, 5, or 7 Miles.

ss.note: For these 4 exercise super set, go on circuit fashion. Do 1A, then 1B, then 1C, then 1D. Go back to 1A to repeat set 2.

ex.note: Jump to 43 seconds in video for attack step tutorial.
For squat jump alternate, hold dumbbells to add weight.
If you dont have a band thats fine just do the exercise without it.
As many clean push-ups as you can get in 7 minutes.
Can use 45 degree hyperextension as well.
Use 8, 10, 12, or 15lb dumbbells.
Each set is a drop set. Perform the set of leg raises with a light dumbbell between your feet. When you get close to failure, drop dumbbell and rep it out until failure bodyweight.
Complete 1200 meters as fast as possible. Pace yourself.
